activity.title: Reflection After the Mock Interview
activity.instructions: After completing the mock interview questions, respond to the reflection prompts. The goal is to notice what felt strong, what felt difficult, and what you want to practice next.

reflection_prompts.question: What went well during your mock interview practice?
reflection_prompts.purpose: Help learners identify strengths and build confidence.

reflection_prompts.question: What is one part of your interview responses that could be improved?
reflection_prompts.purpose: Help learners choose a specific improvement area.

reflection_prompts.question: Which interview question was most difficult to answer, and why?
reflection_prompts.purpose: Help learners identify question types that need more practice.

reflection_prompts.question: Which part of the interview felt most comfortable?
reflection_prompts.purpose: Help learners recognize existing communication strengths.

reflection_prompts.question: Which part felt uncomfortable or unfamiliar?
reflection_prompts.purpose: Help learners identify cultural, language, confidence, or content-related challenges.

reflection_prompts.question: What is one action you will take before your next real interview?
reflection_prompts.purpose: Help learners create a realistic next step.

activity.completion_message: You have completed the mock interview reflection. Review your answers and choose one skill to practice again before your next interview.
